title: Quercetin with Bromelain: Benefits, Dosage & Uses Guide
abstract: # Quercetin with Bromelain: A Complete Guide to Benefits, Dosage, and Uses. One pairing gaining traction combines a flavonoid found in apples and onions with an enzyme from pineapple stems—a combination known as **quercetin with bromelain**. Bromelain — a pineapple enzyme — improves quercetin's bioavailability by up to 3x and adds its own anti-inflammatory benefits. Always consult a healthcare provider before starting new supplements like quercetin with bromelain—especially if you have existing conditions or take medications.
